findings.text: §31's Why says each `record_discovery` call "re-encodes and rewrites the whole persisted store, about 285 MB", but the reckon metadata-index store on disk is 13,717,333 bytes (the file `f4134e45e9e8608144693b5ba79b254394e4480bd2928416c30edc96bdceefc2.json` under `~/.config/reckon/cache/metadata-index/`), and §25's landed evidence records 285,304,266 bytes as the bytes "written per build", not the store's size — read as the per-write store size, 403 rewrites of a 285 MB store cannot encode within the 82.2 s the same paragraph cites
